findings.evidence: docs.yml exports the checked-out commit as JEANSPY_DOCS_REF for release events. The identity shell step was checked for pull_request, push and release environments.

The archive checker requires intended documentation source suffixes and RELEASE.md, excluding docs/_build and regenerated docs/source/api. Missing config, bibliography, template and figure cases are regression-tested.
A parent process applies a 120-second deadline; the worker sets the 16-GiB address-space limit before numerical imports. Required single-thread settings fail fast.
Configuration records are saved before and after each call. Exceptions, warnings and source-hash read failures are retained. Parent timeout/early-exit finalization preserves completed moments.
Base DMModel quadratures require scalar geometry. NFW analytic simple/Evans methods support broadcasting. Executable AST is unchanged after removing docstrings; existing factor tests pass.
Current JeansLikelihoodModel docstring distinguishes nonfinite/negative rejection from clipping nonnegative finite values.
generate_bibliography.tex HTML-decodes the string before character-by-character TeX escaping.
